avis.titre: Barely any trace of vitamin C in this serum.
avis.texte: There is NO Vitamine C in this serum!!! Testing vitamin C serum with indophenol (also known as 2,6-dichlorophenolindophenol or DCPIP) involves adding the serum to a blue-colored indophenol solution; if vitamin C is present, it will reduce the dye to a colorless form, indicating the presence and potentially the concentration of vitamin C. I tested it and it DIDN’T reduce the dye to colorless form. Hence indicating that there is no presence of vitamin C. Even regular milk or applesauce changed color faster than this serum. Amazon is giving me error for posting the video that showed the experiment.
